screens.title: 1 · Entregas: the name and how it is going
screens.why: No subtitle; what is under way shows its day, and the late one is first and red.

pins.label: No subtitle
pins.text: The second line (kind · time · no ritmo) and the value are gone. A row is its name and its bar.

pins.label: Urgente, first
pins.text: Overdue, or time >15 pts ahead of work: urgentFill card + AppTag Urgente (AppIcons.warning, dangerInk). Always first in Em andamento, then the lag rule.

pins.label: The day it is due
pins.text: Red key: 'até amanhã', 'até sex, 6 nov'; 'atrasada N dias' once past. dangerInk when urgent.

pins.label: Green is time
pins.text: '1h de 3h': minutes of done tasks over the whole time, the same share the green bar draws.

pins.label: Not begun: no bar
pins.text: No clock runs yet, so no bar: its time and its day at the end of the line.

pins.label: + Adicionar per section
pins.text: Tempo's add row ends each section. Em andamento: begun at once (asks its day). Não iniciadas: end of the queue.

pins.label: Drag across
pins.text: Long press drags a row up into Em andamento (begins it) or down into Não iniciadas (stops it, lands where dropped). Both headings always drawn.

screens.title: 2 · Begun with no day: asks for one
screens.why: The red bar runs from the start to the deadline, so a delivery needs a day before its clock starts.

pins.label: Dropped in Em andamento
pins.text: Sinastria (no deadline) was dragged up. With a deadline it starts at once, no sheet.

pins.label: Four days to pick
pins.text: Em 3 dias, Em 1 semana (picked), Em 2 semanas, Outro dia (wheel picker). Começar is the one accent.

pins.label: Close cancels
pins.text: Nothing is begun without a day: the row goes back to Não iniciadas where it was.

screens.title: 3 · Begun: placed by the rule
screens.why: Where it was let go does not matter in Em andamento; the order is urgent first, then most behind.

pins.label: Lands by the rule
pins.text: Lag 0 (no time gone, no work): under the urgent one, above Curso de tarô (lag ≈ 0, later in the queue).

pins.label: Its clock starts now
pins.text: '0 min de 2h', 'até ter, 3 nov': the bar fills from started_at to the end of the day picked.
